Home physiotherapy across Ahmedabad

Travelling to a clinic is the hardest part of treatment when you are in pain, recovering from surgery or caring for an elderly parent. PhysioConnect brings the clinic to you. Choose Ahmedabad in the app, select your area, and see physiotherapists who serve your locality, with their qualifications, specialities, reviews and available slots.

Patients use PhysioConnect for home visits in areas such as Satellite, Bodakdev, Vastrapur, Prahlad Nagar, Navrangpura, Thaltej, Bopal, South Bopal, Gota, Chandkheda, Maninagar and along SG Highway. Availability depends on the therapists active near you, so check your exact area in the app.

How booking works

  1. Choose your care mode: a home visit at your doorstep or an online video session.
  2. Pick your city and area to see physiotherapists who serve your locality.
  3. Compare therapists: photo, qualifications, specialities, years of practice, patient reviews and the consultation fee, shown before you book.
  4. Choose a single session or a package of 5, 10 or 15 days, every day or on alternate days.
  5. Pay securely with UPI, card or net banking and get an instant confirmation.

Frequently asked questions

How much does physiotherapy at home cost in Ahmedabad?

Each physiotherapist sets their own fee, and PhysioConnect shows it on their profile before you book. Packages of 5, 10 or 15 sessions are available for longer treatment plans.

Which areas of Ahmedabad do you cover?

Choose Ahmedabad and your area in the app to see physiotherapists who serve your locality. Therapists are matched by distance so home visits stay punctual.

Are the physiotherapists qualified?

Yes. Every therapist on PhysioConnect has a BPT or MPT degree and a council registration number that is verified before they can accept bookings.

Can I book physiotherapy at home for an elderly parent?

Yes. You can book and manage sessions for family members from your own account, and the physiotherapist can call you on WhatsApp for directions to the house.

Do I get a prescription and invoice?

Yes. Your physiotherapist shares a digital prescription with your exercise plan, and you can download a GST invoice for insurance or reimbursement.
